mechanism: Venlafaxine is metabolized by CYP2D6 and CYP3A4; valproate may inhibit these enzymes and increase venlafaxine levels, while both drugs increase CNS depression and serotonergic activity.
action: Monitor for increased venlafaxine toxicity (tremor, confusion, hyponatremia); consider dose adjustment of venlafaxine if combined; assess for additive CNS depression.
